simple.meaning: רֵעַ (rêaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an associate (more or less close).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 189 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 11:3. Its contexts include family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֵעַ (H7453).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רֵעַ (rêaʻ) / H7453 is traced through Genesis 11:3, Genesis 11:7, Genesis 15:10, Genesis 31:49 as a generated source-based concept entry.
